claim: NVIDIA's revenue for the quarter ended October 2025 jumped 62% from a year earlier.
summary: NVIDIA's fiscal Q3 FY2026 ended in October 2025 and revenue was reported up about 62% year-over-year.

sub_claims.text: NVIDIA had a quarterly reporting period ending in October 2025.
sub_claims.note: NVIDIA reports on a fiscal calendar where fiscal Q3 FY2026 ended in late October 2025.

sub_claims.text: NVIDIA's revenue for that quarter was 62% higher than the same quarter a year earlier.
sub_claims.note: From knowledge to 2026-01-04: NVIDIA Q3 FY2026 revenue was about $57.0B versus about $35.1B a year earlier, reported as up about 62% year-over-year in November 2025.
